_source: SPEC.md §6, 'Monte Carlo, full uncertainty' table. 40,000 iterations, seed 7. Tolerance is 2% relative: these were generated by a reference implementation whose RNG stream this one does not reproduce exactly, so agreement is to Monte Carlo error rather than to the digit.

aleatory_all_three._note: Repinned 2026-08-17 when the SPEC.md §5 covariance correction was applied. SPEC.md §6 published 68,300 / 118,300 from the uncorrected model, whose escape rate ran 1.95% below its own derived e in this scenario. The P95 moved +2.5% and so fell outside the 2% tolerance; the P50 moved +0.6% and would have stayed inside it. The claim these figures support -- that parameter uncertainty adds under 2% to D's P95 -- survives, and strengthens: it is now 0.15%. Recorded in SPEC.md §11. Repinned again when the common-random-numbers fix changed the stream; the shift is sampling error.

_note_variance: Was 0.72 before two fixes. The freeze held e_scale at its median (0.860) rather than its mean, and the chunked run used one continuous stream, so coupling between the baseline and frozen runs decayed as 1/n_chunks and most of the run was uncorrelated noise. Measured 70.9% at 150,000 iterations and 71.0% at 40,000, with a bootstrap standard error of 0.4 points.

variance_by_scenario._source: SPEC.md §5 per-scenario decomposition table, measured at 150,000 iterations across seeds 7 and 21. Checked here at 40,000, where the two resolved sources are already stable, with bounds wide enough to cover the larger estimator error at that count.
